name: CreateArtifact

parameters.help_en:
The artifact ID.

This parameter is required to create a new version of an existing artifact.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/469993.html operation to obtain the artifact ID
parameters.help_zh:
部署物ID。

当您要为已有部署物创建新版本时，该参数必填。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/469993.html获取部署物ID
parameters.name: artifact_id

parameters.help_en:
The artifact type.

Valid values:

EcsImage: an ECS image artifact.

AcrImage: a container image artifact.

File: an Object Storage Service (OSS) file artifact.

Script: a script artifact.

HelmChart: a Helm chart artifact
parameters.help_zh:
部署物类型。

取值：

EcsImage：ECS镜像部署物。

AcrImage：容器镜像部署物。

File：Oss文件部署物。

Script：脚本部署物。

HelmChart：HelmChart部署物
parameters.name: artifact_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the artifact to be built. Valid values:

EcsImage: builds an ECS image.

Dockerfile: builds a container image based on a Dockerfile.

Buildpacks: builds a container image based on Buildpacks.

ContainerImage: builds a container image by renaming an existing container image
parameters.help_zh:
构建部署物类型，取值范围：

EcsImage：构建Ecs镜像

Dockerflie：基于Dockerfile构建容器镜像

Buildpacks：基于Buildpacks构建容器镜像

ContainerImage：基于已有容器镜像重命名构建容器镜像
